steps.name: h1b-1-hub-library-editor
steps.verify: export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && cd tools/orb-manager && go vet ./... && go test -run 'HubEditor|LibraryOrigin' -v . | tail -40 && go test -run 'HubEditor|LibraryOrigin' . && go test -run 'TestHubEditorServesTheLibrarysEditorWithNoOrb|TestHubEditorRefusesWhatItDoesNotCarry|TestHubEditorLetsGoWhenTheFileChanges|TestLibraryOriginOnThemeRows' -v . | grep -c '^--- PASS' | grep -qx 4 && go test ./... && cd ../.. && test -z "$(git diff --stat h1 -- tools/orb-manager/contract/ tools/orb-manager/web apps)"

steps.name: h1b-2-session-hub-editor
steps.verify: export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && R=$PWD && cd tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest && node headless-gorbhost.test.js | tail -3 | grep -q 'all green' && node headless-session.test.js | tail -1 | grep -q 'all green' && node headless-send.test.js && PY=python3 node headless-test.js && cd $R/apps/clock/editor/_selftest && node headless-test.js && GORB_HOST='{"kind":"hub"}' NODE_OPTIONS="--require=$R/tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest/gorb-host-preload.js" node headless-test.js && cd $R && grep -q '/editor/hub/' tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest/headless-gorbhost.test.js && test -z "$(git diff h1 -- tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/_selftest/headless-gorbhost.test.js tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/theme@1/session.js | grep '^-[^-]')" && test -z "$(git diff --name-only h1 -- tools/orb-manager/contract apps tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/theme@1/send.js tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/host@1 tools/orb-manager/web/app.js tools/orb-manager/web/index.html)" && make check-web && make check-runner && node -e "for (const f of ['tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/theme@1/session.js','tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/theme@1/send.js']) new Function(require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf8'))"

steps.name: h1b-3-library-import-door
steps.verify: export GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && R=$PWD && cd tools/orb-manager && node --check web/app.js && node --check web/tabs.js && go test -run 'TestSiteImportDoorInTheLibrary' -v . | grep -q '^--- PASS: TestSiteImportDoorInTheLibrary' && go test -run 'SiteImport|AppJS|ThemeEditor|ThemeRows|LibraryDoor' . && go vet ./... && go test ./... && cd web/runtime/_selftest && PY=python3 node headless-test.js && node headless-gorbhost.test.js | tail -3 | grep -q 'all green' && cd $R && test -z "$(git diff --stat h1 -- tools/orb-manager/contract/ apps tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/theme@1/send.js tools/orb-manager/web/runtime/host@1)" && make check-web
